name: cRZCmdLine::operator= (assign from another command line: refcount, argument vector via 0x1420af, text, empty string)
notes: Hooked (cRZCmdLine_Assign), not run in-game. 0x1420af (the vector assignment it calls) is a library match, so CopyArguments is our equivalent and is covered by this test: 1500 cases of random source/target argument counts, targets shrunk by erasing arguments (size < capacity), self-assignment, junk in the empty string; compares the return, refcount, size and capacity of the vector, every argument with its string capacity, text and empty string. Mutants: refcount copy removed, count >= capacity, no geometric growth, CopyForward removed, empty string not copied, last element skipped in the reuse loop: all killed.

name: cRZCmdLine program-path step (make argument 0 the program's full path; text from GetModulePath or a cIGZString)
notes: Hooked (cRZCmdLine_ParseProgramPath), not run in-game. cdecl (cmd, text). 4000 cases: module path via the wide/narrow fakes (including a narrow fallback and an empty path), a real cRZString, a fake string whose Strlen is shorter than its data (the log pins slot 7 before slot 6), an empty string; argument 0 matching or not; names with dots, separators, colons, case differences, empty first argument. Compares the whole command line afterwards and the fakes' call log. ORIGINAL-BUG: the 512-byte stack buffer is filled by strncpy without a length check (text of 512 or more characters overruns the stack); the test stays under 512. Mutants: directory cut off by one, first dot instead of last, lowercasing removed, argument 0 not erased, empty-path guard removed, path default for text removed, Strlen/Data order swapped, argc >= 0: all killed.

name: cRZStopwatch::ElapsedAsFloat (total as a float via _ltod3, scaled by the mode's factor; __thiscall ret 4)
notes: Hooked (cRZStopwatch_ElapsedAsFloat), not run in-game. 20000 scripted-clock cases as tests/rz_stopwatch.cpp's Elapsed test (modes -2..8, overhead edges, wrapped spans, counts past 53 bits and float ties) compare the float bits, the number of counter reads and the whole stopwatch; mode 0 (time-stamp counter, not scriptable) only back to back within a tolerance. Mutants: span >= overhead, no-tick fallback 0, scale index off by one, mode range 2..5, unknown mode result 1.0f: killed; int64->float without the double step: survived, equivalent (MSVC converts int64 to float through _ltod3 + cvtsd2ss either way). Lane FA: mode 0 differentially, tests/stopwatch_tsc.cpp cRZStopwatch_ElapsedAsFloatMode0: the time-stamp helper 0x1c9244 and the QueryPerformanceCounter slot scripted on both sides, 6000 cases (overhead 0 and random, the unused time-stamp timebase 0x10cb678 junk-filled with a different overhead, accumulated 0 / past 2^53 / float tie / >= 2^63 / random, start 0 / ~0 / 2^32 / 0xffffffff, now at the overhead, one past, one short, wrapped and random), comparing the float bits (output prefilled with a NaN), the counter reads (one time-stamp read when started, no performance-counter read) and the whole stopwatch; the overhead cell checked to be the image's (ctx.image.At). The 20000-case modes -2..8 test stays in tests/framework_startup.cpp. Mutants: killed: mode 0 reading the performance counter, mode 0 subtracting 0x10cb678's overhead, the mode-0 overhead edge >=, mode 0 converted unsigned, mode 0 reading the counter when stopped.

name: cRZStopwatch::ElapsedAs64 (total as a 64-bit count; modes 2..6 the scaled float truncated, low 32 bits only; __thiscall ret 4)
notes: Hooked (cRZStopwatch_ElapsedAs64), not run in-game. 20000 scripted-clock cases like the float one, comparing the 64-bit result (the high half is 0 for modes 2..6), counter reads and the stopwatch; mode 0 only back to back. Mutants: scaled value kept as 64 bits, mode 0 treated as unknown, span >= overhead: killed. Lane FA: mode 0 differentially, tests/stopwatch_tsc.cpp cRZStopwatch_ElapsedAs64Mode0: the time-stamp helper 0x1c9244 and the QueryPerformanceCounter slot scripted on both sides, 6000 cases (overhead 0 and random, the unused time-stamp timebase 0x10cb678 junk-filled with a different overhead, accumulated 0 / past 2^53 / float tie / >= 2^63 / random, start 0 / ~0 / 2^32 / 0xffffffff, now at the overhead, one past, one short, wrapped and random), comparing the 64-bit result (output prefilled 0xa5), the counter reads (one time-stamp read when started, no performance-counter read) and the whole stopwatch; the overhead cell checked to be the image's (ctx.image.At). The 20000-case modes -2..8 test stays in tests/framework_startup.cpp. Mutants: killed: mode 0 reading the performance counter, mode 0 subtracting 0x10cb678's overhead, the mode-0 overhead edge >=, mode 0 kept to the low 32 bits, mode 0 reading the counter when stopped.

name: cRZStopwatch::Stop (add the span since Start less the overhead, or one tick, to the accumulated count; clear the start)
notes: Hooked (cRZStopwatch_Stop), not run in-game. Always reads QueryPerformanceCounter, so every mode (mode 0 included) is scripted: 20000 cases, compares accumulated count, start, counter reads and the whole stopwatch. ORIGINAL-BUG: a mode 0 stopwatch is started from the time-stamp counter but stopped with the performance counter. Mutants: start not cleared, time-stamp read in mode 0, span >= overhead, one-tick fallback 0: killed.
